subject: Committee Operating Rules and Communications Strategy
overview: The committee established its internal governance procedures, approved an onboarding process for new members, and finalized a communications plan for the project's eligibility phase.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes for the previous full committee meeting and the Rules and Onboarding and Communications subcommittees.

items.title: Committee Operating Rules and Onboarding
items.summary: Approved a set of governance rules emphasizing first-name address and established a checklist to orient future members to the project's technical and legal requirements.

items.title: Communications and Community Engagement Strategy
items.summary: Approved an outreach plan involving a dedicated project website, community surveys, school tours, and a "roadshow" presentation to engage residents without students in the district.

items.title: Chapter 74 Vocational Program Capacity
items.summary: Reviewed a draft report for the Massachusetts School Building Authority detailing current vocational enrollment and proposed capacity expansions aligned with regional workforce needs.
